bio:
b. 25 Sep 1914; enlisted in the US Army at Scranton on 17 Feb 1941; married Mildred Leona; d. 21 Apr 1997. Listed as Rocco in the 1920 census.

As 'Rocco Petrillo' he survived his sister Josephine Castellano in November 1995 ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] Obituary, Josephine Castellano, The Arizona Republic (Phoenix), 29 Nov 1995 (clipping image attached to FamilySearch tree GQWT-QQ6, collection 'Arizona, Gila, Payson, Obituaries', ark 1:1:Q2WQ-L25P). (secondary) https://ancestors.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/sources/GQWT-QQ6/images/i/2/image.jpg
